expected_findings.root_cause: tornado availability is snapshotted into a module constant at import time while the decorator still dereferences the live tornado global
expected_findings.failure_path: a test suite sets tenacity.tornado = None to exercise the non-tornado path; _HAS_TORNADO is still True, so retry() evaluates tornado.gen.is_coroutine_function and raises AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'gen'; setting tenacity.tornado = None is the documented way downstream test suites exercise the non-tornado path (tenacity #696), so the inconsistency is reachable in supported usage
